title: Computing Saddle Points in Stiff Problems via a Preconditioned High-index Saddle Dynamics Method
summary: High-index saddle dynamics (HiSD) is an effective approach for computing saddle points of a prescribed Morse index and constructing solution landscapes for complex nonlinear systems. However, for problems with ill-conditioned Hessians arising from fine discretizations or stiff potentials, the efficiency of standard HiSD deteriorates as its convergence rate worsens with the spectral condition number $κ$.
